Provides various multidimensional scaling (MDS) algorithms including
classical MDS (Torgerson), nonmetric MDS (Kruskal), individual
differences MDS (INDSCAL), ellipse model (Okada-Imaizumi), HFM (Chino),
and von Mises model (Shojima). Includes an interactive Shiny application
for GUI-based analysis and visualization.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as_proximity()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/as_proximity.md)
  : Coerce data to a square proximity matrix
- [`asym_decomp()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/asym_decomp.md)
  : Decompose a square matrix into symmetric and skew-symmetric parts
- [`gstatis_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/gstatis_mds.md)
  : GSTATIS: STATIS for a set of asymmetric matrices via Hermitian forms
- [`hfm_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/hfm_mds.md)
  : Hermitian form model for asymmetric proximities
- [`missing_pattern()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/missing_pattern.md)
  : Missing-value patterns of asymmetric proximity matrices
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace.md)
  : Plot the configuration of an mdspace object
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_asym>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_asym.md)
  : Plot the skew-symmetric part as a heat map
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_gstatis>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_gstatis.md)
  : Plot a GSTATIS solution
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_hfm>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_hfm.md)
  : Plot one complex plane of an HFM solution
- [`print(`*`<mdspace>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/print.mdspace.md)
  : Print an mdspace object
- [`run_app()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/run_app.md)
  : mdspace Shiny アプリケーションを起動する
- [`summary(`*`<mdspace>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/summary.mdspace.md)
  : Summarize an mdspace object
